sloka: लोकस्य पापानि विनाशयन्तम् ।महोदधिं चापि समेधयन्तम् ।भूतानि सर्वाणि विराजयन्तम् ।ददर्श शीताम्शुमथाभियान्तम् ॥५-५-२॥
transliteration: lokasya pāpāni vināśayantam ।mahodadhiṁ cāpi samedhayantam ।bhūtāni sarvāṇi virājayantam ।dadarśa śītāmśumathābhiyāntam ॥5-5-2॥

translations.english: While moving forward, Hanuman saw the Moon spreading his light, thereby warding off the agony of all creatures, causing the swelling of the ocean and illuminating the earth as well as the sky.
